On 3/17/2020, the firm received a complaint regarding the presence of a foreign particle embedded on Hydrocodone/Acetaminophen Tablets 10mg/325mg, batch S901339. Based on the firm's investigation, CN-000073, the black particle was identified as [redacted] rubber containing a [redacted] filler. The root cause was identified as loose black particles shedding from a mount of the [redacted] used during manufacturing process. Upon examination of the Equipment ID # 819, which was utilized for manufacturing of the subject bulk batch S901086 on [redacted] the firm identified that the mounts under the had an appearance of shedding particles. During handling of drums while operation, the particles could fall into the blend, and move forward to compression, encapsulation or packaging of finished product. This was identified as a non-dedicated machine utilized for multiple products. The firm neither expanded the investigation to other batches of Hydrocodone/Acetaminophen Tablets 10mg/325mg of the same campaign, nor other products manufactured using this [redacted].
